Our City of London Location

An Implant Clinic in the Heart of the City

Dental Implants London — City of London brings our implant-focused dentistry to EC4. Located at 5 Ave Maria Lane, moments from St Paul's Cathedral, the clinic is designed around the needs of City workers, residents and visitors — with early morning and needs of City workers, residents and visitors — with early morning appointments from 8:00am, Monday to Friday.

From an initial implant consultation through to long-term implant maintenance, our team provides assessment, planning and treatment for single missing teeth through to full-arch rehabilitation.

Address

5 Ave Maria Lane
London EC4M 7AQ

Getting There

Easy to Reach From Anywhere in the City

By Underground

  • St Paul's (Central line) — approximately 3 minutes on foot
  • Blackfriars (Circle & District lines) — approximately 5 minutes on foot

By Train & Bus

  • Blackfriars national rail (Thameslink services) is around a 5-minute walk
  • Numerous bus routes serve the St Paul's, Ludgate Hill and Fleet Street area

On Foot

  • St Paul's Cathedral — moments away
  • Paternoster Square — a short walk
  • Old Bailey — nearby on Ludgate Hill
Implant-Focused Dentistry

Dental Implant Treatments in the City of London

A concise overview of the implant treatments available at our City clinic. Each links to a detailed treatment guide. Suitability for any treatment is confirmed at a clinical assessment.

Single Tooth Implants

Replace one missing tooth with a titanium implant and custom zirconia crown.

Learn More

Multiple Dental Implants

Replace several missing teeth with individual implants or implant-supported restorations.

Learn More

All-on-4 Dental Implants

Full-arch replacement supported by four strategically placed implants.

Learn More

Implant-Supported Bridges

Fixed bridges anchored by implants — no need to prepare healthy adjacent teeth.

Learn More

Full Arch Implant Bridges

A fixed, non-removable bridge replacing a complete arch of teeth.

Learn More

Immediate-Load Dental Implants

Same-day temporary teeth in suitable cases, subject to clinical assessment.

Learn More

Mini Dental Implants

Narrow-diameter implants for denture stabilisation or limited-space cases.

Learn More

Implant-Retained Dentures

Secure loose dentures with implants for improved stability and confidence.

Learn More

Bone Grafting

Rebuild jawbone volume where needed to support implant placement.

Learn More

Full-Mouth Reconstruction

Comprehensive rehabilitation combining implants and restorative dentistry.

Learn More

Dentures

Modern partial and complete dentures, including implant-stabilised options.

Learn More

For pricing details, see our dental implant cost guide, or explore the conditions we treat.

Inside the Clinic

Our City of London Clinic

Clinical Team

The Dental Implants London Team

Our City of London clinic is supported by the experienced Dental Implants London clinical team. The clinician for your appointment is confirmed when you book.

Dr. Sam Parsno

Implant Dentist

BDS (Sweden), DipImpDent RCS (Eng.), MSc ImpDent URJC (Spain)

GDC: 72207

Over 30 years of clinical experience in implant and advanced restorative dentistry, trained at the Brånemark Implant Centre in Gothenburg, with a Diploma in Implant Dentistry from the Royal College of Surgeons and an MSc in Implant Dentistry from Rey Juan Carlos University, Madrid.

Dr. Kamran Yazdi

Dentist

DDS, MSc Conservative Dentistry (UCL), Dip Oral Dental Science (UCL)

GDC: 197926

Postgraduate training in Oral Dental Science and Conservative Dentistry at the Eastman Dental Hospital (UCL), with a conservative, patient-led approach to restorative and implant-supported treatment.

Meet the full clinical team

Why Dental Implants London

Implant Dentistry, Done Properly

Implant-Focused Experience

GDC-registered clinicians with formal postgraduate implant training and extensive experience across single-tooth to full-arch cases.

Thorough Planning

Every treatment begins with clinical examination and imaging, followed by a personalised written treatment plan with transparent pricing.

Quality Materials

Medical-grade titanium implants and custom zirconia crowns, with all-inclusive pricing from £2,950 per tooth and 0% finance available (subject to status).

Ongoing Aftercare

Structured follow-up and long-term implant maintenance support, with hygiene care to help protect your investment.
